review_candidates.title: IT Operations Engineer II
review_candidates.description: Join Our Team As part of our Cinemark Universe, you'll discover fun opportunities with real growth potential and plenty of perks. With 500+ theatres and nearly 6,000 screens; we're truly a global presence of 20,000 movie lovers working together to make unforgettable experiences. Role Summary This role sits on the End User Experience team within Cinemark's IT Operations organization, which owns the End User Device Management, End User Application Management, End User Remote Access, Collaboration, Communications and Voice, Meeting Room and Audio Visual, Print Services and Equipment Reservation services. The team is the day-to-day face of IT for Cinemark's corporate staff, keeping everyone productive across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. A proficient operations engineer who independently owns recurring operational work end-to-end within the team's service area. The engineer resolves a broad range of incidents and requests, executes standard changes, and improves the runbooks the team relies on. We are standing up a new program that uses artificial intelligence to automate and deflect routine operations work across corporate IT. It is early days, so you will get in at the start and help shape how it works. In this role you will primarily support Cinemark's United States-based corporate staff. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Independently resolve incidents and service requests across the team's service area, owning them to closure in ServiceNow. Execute standard and pre-approved changes in line with change management. Support problem management by gathering data and assisting with root-cause analysis. Author and improve runbooks and knowledge base articles. Carry the on-call rotation independently, with subject-matter experts ready to jump in on the most unusual problems. Operate the team's core toolset proficiently across multiple platforms. Be available to assist in emergencies. Travel as needed. Perform other duties as assigned by management or the department head. Education And Skills Required Hands-on proficiency with managing endpoints and end-user applications, the Microsoft 365 collaboration suite, meeting-room audio-visual systems, remote support, and endpoint security across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, with PowerShell and Terraform automation. 2 to 4 years of IT operations or infrastructure experience. Solid grasp of ITIL incident, request, and change management. ServiceNow experience. Participation in the on-call rotation. Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience. 2 to 4 years of relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications Relevant End User Experience certifications: Microsoft 365 or Modern Desktop certifications, Apple device management certifications, and ITIL. Scripting or automation familiarity, such as PowerShell or Python. Spanish or Portuguese language skills. Extra Information You will spend much of your time on incidents, requests, and standard changes, with regular time set aside to improve runbooks and automate routine work. Tools and platforms: ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot for Microsoft 365, PowerShell, Terraform, PolyCom, Symantec Endpoint Protection, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and Splashtop Remote Support. Reports to: the End User Experience IT Operations Manager. Work schedule: Hybrid, with 4 days in office and 1 day remote. On-call: You join the on-call rotation about four times a year. Each turn runs two weeks, one week as the primary responder and then one week as secondary support. Whoever is on call is backed by subject-matter experts in each area, and the team is always willing and ready to jump in. On-call is part of the role and is factored into base pay. Travel: Limited; typically under 10 percent. System of record: ServiceNow is used for all operational wok. Benefits Available At Cinemark, we believe every team member should feel like a hero. Each career comes with a variety of blockbuster benefits for both hourly and salaried team members. Any change amendments, or modifications may be implemented even though they have not been communicated, reprinted or substituted in this job description. review_candidates.title: Exchange & Security Administrator, AVP
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Looking For State Street is looking for an M365 Exchange & Security Engineer to become part of our Collaboration Services team in Boston. Why this role is important to us The role will help deliver the Collaboration Services roadmap, modernize mail flow and threat-protection capabilities, strengthen operational resilience and provide support for business and technical users of these services. Working with the tower lead, architects, engineers, operations teams and key control partners, the engineer will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution engineering, implementation, documentation and advanced support across Exchange and email security. What You Will Be Responsible For As the Collaboration Services M365 Exchange & Security Engineer you will Engineer, configure and support Exchange Online, Exchange hybrid and remaining on-premises Exchange services, including mail flow, transport rules, connectors, accepted domains, certificates, TLS, message routing, RBAC and service integrations. Engineer and support Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and third-party email security services, including anti-phishing, anti-spam, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, quarantine and threat investigation. Design, test and implement roadmap changes such as Exchange Server Subscription Edition lifecycle work, mailbox and public-folder migrations, cloud mail-flow modernization, legacy platform decommissioning and retirement of technical debt. Provide advanced engineering support for production issues involving mail flow, message tracing, delivery failures, permissions, authentication, certificates, encryption, service health and Microsoft 365 interoperability. Support secure onboarding of applications and platforms to Exchange services, including SMTP relay, connectors, service principals, APIs and approved automation accounts. Support email encryption and data-protection capabilities, including Microsoft Purview Message Encryption, RMS behaviour, external recipient experience and integration with third-party email security and DLP platforms. Provide advanced support during major incidents, lead technical troubleshooting, engage Microsoft and other vendors, identify root cause and document corrective and preventive actions. Develop and maintain PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for repeatable engineering, administration, reporting, validation, monitoring and support activities. Design and maintain least-privilege administrative access using Microsoft 365 RBAC and enterprise identity-governance processes. Create and maintain solution designs, technical standards, implementation plans, test plans, operational procedures, recovery procedures, support documentation and user guidance. Prepare for and participate in audit activities, provide technical evidence and remediate control or documentation gaps. Monitor Microsoft product changes and roadmap announcements, assess service impact and convert relevant changes into planned engineering or operational work. Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, simplify the service estate and improve operational processes through standardisation and automation. Provide knowledge transfer and technical guidance to engineering and operations teams, and support controlled handover of new capabilities into production. What We Value These skills will help you succeed in this role Deep hands-on engineering and support experience with Exchange Online and Exchange hybrid or on-premises environments, including transport, connectors, mail routing, certificates, TLS, RBAC, mailbox management and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and enterprise email security controls, including threat policies, investigation, quarantine and mail-flow protection. Experience designing and supporting integrations between Exchange, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and third-party email security, DLP, archive or encryption platforms. Strong PowerShell skills for Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 engineering and administration; experience with Microsoft Graph, APIs, Power Automate or Python is beneficial. Practical knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, authentication, Conditional Access, enterprise applications, service principals, privileged access and least-privilege design. Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to email, including Message Encryption, sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery and Audit. Experience with Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls in a large, regulated enterprise, including audit evidence, control testing, change management and risk remediation. Ability to troubleshoot complex end-to-end issues across cloud services, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networking, DNS, certificates and third-party integrations. Experience with service monitoring, incident management, problem management, change implementation, testing and operational readiness. Ability to work independently, lead technical workstreams and collaborate effectively with engineers, operations teams, control partners and vendors. Detailed and organised critical thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on service resilience, security and supportability. Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, options and recommendations clearly. Education And Preferred Qualifications A degree in Computer Science (or a related discipline) or 5 or more years of equivalent work experience.
